description: This file provides functions for caching and retrieving Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) data in a database using SQLAlchemy ORM. It defines two main functions: get_cached_apod for fetching cached APOD data and set_cached_apod for inserting or updating cache entries.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None get_cached_apod(db: Session, apod_date: date, hd: bool)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached APOD entry from the database based on date and HD preference.

methods.name: None set_cached_apod(db: Session, apod: dict[str, Any], hd: bool)
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cached APOD entry in the database based on provided data.
